cases.name: newer-stalled-dispatch-existing-pending-wait

cases.name: original-and-newer-precanceled-entry

cases.name: source-disposed-before-observer-admission

cases.name: caller-wait-handle-remains-owned

cases.name: original-cutoff-and-monotonic-unchanged
